physical_direction_rule: In the fixed 1758 high-side polar frame with weak-scale physical row labels, eigenvectors O of A† diag(w_e,w_mu,w_tau) A define a positive two-leg filter. The two original Dirac masses are assigned to these axes by a separate ordering rule. A low-polar alternate reference is tested explicitly.
main_weights: MZ charged Yukawa central values squared; single charged-lepton spectral projectors and equal row responses as controls.
positive_witness: Prefactor assigned in increasing charged-role eigenvalue order, common pole mass equal to the upper archived Dirac mass; four serial identical propagations per leg. This discrete setting was found in a list comparison, independently of oscillations in its mass value only.
closures: The independent atmospheric central .57 and the additional exchange condition |U_mu3|=|U_tau3| are evaluated separately. The latter removes a phase degree of freedom up to two solutions but is not an adopted principle.
units: GeV for masses. Dimensionless one-loop effective model. No additional local or high-scale matching when transporting the low-energy Yukawa readings into the source frame is implied.
